paired_baseline: V0_pred in the same focus convention
rendering: Uniform corrected FP16 pathway; K64 rendering, K16 nominal-focus near transmission diagnostic. Identical numerical focal distances reuse a render inside the same run.

far_visible_hidden.protocol: K64 at fixed GT focus. Hidden hit means a ray receives positive GT substitute compositing weight.

sharing_3c.comparison: Observed 3c train time; official checkpoint-evaluation pauses are outside its accumulated train timer.
